entries.explanation: Core physical and mental stats (Strength, Agility, Wits, Empathy) that define what your character is good at.

entries.explanation: Defensive reaction that spends an action to reduce or negate an incoming attack before it lands.

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Catastrophic failure on a roll — often when no successes are rolled and at least one die shows 1.
entries.citation: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document — SRD — Botch

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Structured pursuit where participants roll to close distance or escape each round.
entries.citation: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document — SRD — Chases

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Temporary state such as Exhausted or Scared that imposes penalties until cleared or reduced.
entries.citation: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document — SRD — Conditions

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Terrain that makes you harder to hit; attackers suffer penalties or lose dice.

entries.explanation: Exceptional success on a roll — often extra damage or a bonus effect depending on the game.

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Target number of successes the GM sets for a task based on how hard the action is.

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Carrying too much; movement and physical rolls may suffer until you drop weight.

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Points earned from play spent to improve skills or gain talents between sessions.
entries.citation: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document — SRD — Experience

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Quick action such as drawing a weapon, ducking, or reloading in many YZE games.
entries.citation: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document — SRD — Actions

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Equipment and supplies tracked on your sheet; may provide bonuses or consumable uses.
entries.citation: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document — SRD — Gear

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Health pool; when reduced to zero you risk critical injuries or death depending on the game.
entries.citation: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document — SRD — Hit Points

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Roll at the start of combat to determine turn order for the round.
entries.citation: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document — SRD — Initiative

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Supernatural powers defined by the specific YZE game; usually costs willpower or similar resource.

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Overwhelmed by fear; you must flee or cower and cannot act normally until the condition clears.

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: After a roll you may push to reroll unset dice, but you suffer a condition or stress for the risk.

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Distance bands (point-blank, short, long) that affect whether attacks are possible and how hard they are.

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Rest, comfort, or downtime activity that removes accumulated stress between intense scenes.

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Trained ability tied to an attribute; you roll attribute + skill when attempting related tasks.
entries.citation: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document — SRD — Skills

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Extra d6 dice from your trained skill level, rolled alongside base dice on skill checks.

entries.explanation: One of your two actions per round; used for heavier activities like aiming or moving far.

entries.explanation: Skill to move quietly and stay unseen; opposed by observers’ perception in many scenes.

entries.explanation: Mental strain from horror or pressure; in many YZE games pushing rolls adds stress that must be relieved.

entries.explanation: Food, ammo, or consumables tracked on the sheet; depletes during travel and downtime.

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Special ability or edge purchased with experience that bends the core rules in your favor.

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Overland movement between scenes; may consume time, supplies, and trigger encounters.
entries.citation: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document — SRD — Travel

entries.explanation: Mounted or driven transport with its own stats, damage tracks, and maneuver rules.
entries.citation: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document — SRD — Vehicles

entries.explanation: Gear used to attack; defines damage, range, and special traits for combat rolls.
entries.citation: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document — SRD — Weapons

source.documentTitle: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document

entries.explanation: Resource spent to resist fear, use powers, or push beyond normal limits in many YZE games.
entries.citation: Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document — SRD — Willpower
